{{Quote|Acceptable casualties, on our side. Darth Atroxa remains a threat, but I'm confident she will be neutralized. With her downfall, victory will be ours.|[[Thexan]]|<ref name="Brothers">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20150728|text="Brothers"|int=Brothers (short story)}}</ref>}}
'''Darth Atroxa'''<ref name="Brothers" /> was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|campaigns]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Atroxa took control of the forces [[Attack on Korriban|defending]] the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]] by [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Arcann]] of the Eternal Empire.<ref name="Sacrifice" />
